hints.title: Nodes of Interest
hints.text: The only necessary transit locations are start, target, and the endpoints of all special roads.

hints.title: Direct Manhattan Edge Costs
hints.text: Between any two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), the standard cost is abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2).

hints.title: Shortest Path Across Critical Points
hints.text: Explore paths from start using priority distances, jumping directly to target or through special road shortcuts.

hints.title: Dijkstra Over Waypoints Implementation

variables: R: number of special roads (up to 200)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Continuous coordinate search is intractable over a 10^5 x 10^5 plane.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(R) auxiliary space for filtered endpoints and distance map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduces infinite coordinate grid to a finite graph of special road endpoints.
